stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: A power line failure in Virginia showed that data centers (the giant computer facilities that run AI and cloud services) don't handle electrical problems well. Engineers think they can fix this.
stories.why_it_matters: If data centers fail more often, the services you rely on online could go down — like email, cloud storage, or AI tools you use for your business.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a special keyboard tool that helps computer programmers write code using AI. Most regular people won't use it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software developers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company is raising money to automate routine computer work (like filling forms or organizing files) instead of just writing code.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors and tech companies — not something affecting your daily life yet.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, a company that makes AI picture-generators, bought an astrology app called Co-Star.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a business move between tech companies — nothing that changes what you can do with AI.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: An AI company bought another company to make its coding assistant talk in a friendlier, more helpful way.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows companies believe making AI more pleasant to talk to is just as important as making it smarter — this could mean better AI helpers for everyone over time.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google used to send lots of visitors to websites for free, and websites accepted this trade-off. Now that deal is breaking down and websites are losing traffic.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business that depends on Google traffic, this is worth paying attention to — you may need new ways to reach customers online.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5 that costs less money and has fewer restrictions than their previous version.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to businesses using AI tools — it could make AI services cheaper and more available.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Claude Opus 5 with nearly the same abilities as their most powerful version, but cheaper.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make AI tools more affordable for small businesses and regular people who want to use them.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) is adding new features to its AI assistant so it can help you with your calendar, planning, and research like other popular AI tools do.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Facebook or Instagram, you may soon have an AI helper available — similar to what Google and OpenAI already offer.

stories.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
stories.simple_summary: Tech companies are asking the U.S. government not to ban or heavily restrict open-weight AI models (AI tools that anyone can copy and use).
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a policy debate between government and big tech companies — nothing affecting you directly right now.

stories.title: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
stories.simple_summary: Bluesky's AI assistant can now help you search for and understand news and conversations on the Bluesky social network.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Bluesky, you have a new tool to find information — otherwise this is just a feature update on a social network.

stories.title: Midjourney acquired the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney (an AI image-generator company) bought Co-Star, an astrology app.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a business deal between tech companies — nothing that changes what you can do with AI.
